title: AI × Bio 每日精选
subtitle: 计算生物学、组学、蛋白质与生物医学模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: RePurpose: An LLM-Assisted, Source-Traceable Drug Repurposing Tool with Retrospective Validation on Clemastine in Multiple Sclerosis
items.abstract_or_text: Summary: Thus far, evidence for drug repurposing is contained in target-, drug-, trial-, and literature-based data sources that are challenging to synthesize for non-specialists. Here, we introduce RePurpose, a web-based tool that takes as input a topic written in plain language and returns candidate drugs built from data in Open Targets, ClinicalTrials.gov, UniProt, and PubMed. For queries in the form of a goal, RePurpose filters candidate drugs by whether they modulate all targets implicated in the goal in the corresponding direction. Every candidate has a source that contributes evidence: a structured database, a clinical trial, or a proposal from a large language model. An adjustable ranking adjusts the order of candidates from well-studied to less well-known candidate drugs. We retrospectively tested RePurpose with the trial drug clemastine, which was being considered as a remyelinating agent in multiple sclerosis (MS). RePurpose retrieved clemastine in each replicate of the mechanism-worded queries, but in no replicates of the disease-worded queries, and no structured query retrieved it without the language model enabled. Its ranked outputs reflected the evidence supporting clemastine but not later evidence of harm in progressive MS, which was reachable only through an on-demand literature search. Our results imply that RePurpose may be better at tracing evidence around a hypothesis than generating new hypotheses. Availability and Implementation RePurpose Pharma is freely accessible at https://www.repurposepharma.com/. For code and more information on the application, see: https://github.com/nayagamnitin-hub/RePurpose-Pharma.
items.summary_zh: RePurpose是一个可追溯来源的LLM辅助药物再利用工具，并以多发性硬化中的clemastine进行回顾性验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工具把多源证据连接到候选药物，但案例显示其更适合追踪既有假设，不能替代主动的安全性文献检索。
items.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，药物再利用的证据分散在靶点、药物、试验和文献数据源中，非专业人士很难综合这些信息。我们介绍RePurpose，这是一个基于网页的工具，输入用自然语言书写的主题后，利用Open Targets、ClinicalTrials.gov、UniProt和PubMed中的数据返回候选药物。对于目标形式的查询，RePurpose会根据候选药物是否以相应方向调节该目标所涉及的全部靶点来进行筛选。每个候选药物都有一个提供证据的来源：结构化数据库、临床试验或大型语言模型提出的建议。可调节的排序功能会将候选药物从研究充分到研究较少进行排列。我们使用曾被考虑作为多发性硬化症（MS）再髓鞘化药物的试验药物clemastine，对RePurpose进行了回顾性测试。在机制措辞的查询中，RePurpose在每次重复实验中都检索到clemastine，但在疾病措辞的查询中一次也没有检索到；如果不启用语言模型，结构化查询也无法检索到它。其排序结果反映了支持clemastine的证据，但没有反映进行性MS中后来出现的危害证据；这些证据只能通过按需文献检索获得。我们的结果表明，RePurpose可能更适合围绕一个假设追踪证据，而不是生成新的假设。RePurpose Pharma可免费访问于https://www.repurposepharma.com/。应用的代码和更多信息见：https://github.com/nayagamnitin-hub/RePurpose-Pharma。

items.title: A systematic investigation of molecular encoding methods for drug property predictions across neural network and Transformer encoder-based model
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Fundamental investigations into how different molecular encoding methods affect molecular property prediction remain relatively limited. In this study, we extensively examined the optimal molecular encoding methods for molecular properties prediction using two prevalent structure designs: neural network model (MLP) and a Transformer encoder-based model (MLP + TL). For molecular encoding methods, we investigated several types of fingerprints, including traditional topological fingerprints, substructure-based fingerprints, and string-based representations. These two models were trained on seven well-known molecular datasets to evaluate different input molecular encoding methods based on evaluation metrics. On several biologically relevant classification tasks, including toxicity, mutagenicity, and side-effect prediction, our models consistently achieved average AUC values above 0.9. Beyond model performance, we further explored whether the Transformer encoder-based framework could provide interpretable insight. Rather than relying on external post-hoc explanation methods such as the local interpretable model-agnostic explanation (LIME) or the Deep SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), we leveraged the model’s intrinsic attention weights as an internal interpretability signal for identifying potentially important feature. To further support this analysis, we conducted case studies on the BBBP and MUTAG datasets. The MLP + TL model using MACCS and PubChem as input can capture chemically interpretable groups that determined the major blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability and mutagenicity in Salmonella typhimurium . In particular, a comparison between Morphine and Heroin highlighted the role of hydroxyl-related substructures in BBB permeability prediction, which was consistently reflected in the attention weights. Overall, our findings provide practical guidance for selecting effective molecular encoding methods and contribute to the development of interpretable molecular informatics approaches for drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 系统比较多种分子编码在神经网络和Transformer模型药物性质预测中的作用，并分析内在注意力可解释性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖7个分子数据集和毒性、致突变性、侧作用等任务，为分子表示选择及化学解释提供了可操作证据。
items.abstract_zh: 关于不同分子编码方法如何影响分子性质预测的基础研究仍相对有限。在本研究中，我们使用两种常见的结构设计——神经网络模型（MLP）和基于Transformer编码器的模型（MLP + TL）——系统考察分子性质预测的最佳分子编码方法。对于分子编码方法，我们研究了多种指纹，包括传统拓扑指纹、基于子结构的指纹和基于字符串的表示。这两种模型在7个广为人知的分子数据集上进行训练，以基于评估指标比较不同输入分子编码方法。在包括毒性、致突变性和副作用预测在内的多个生物学相关分类任务中，我们的模型持续取得超过0.9的平均AUC。除模型性能外，我们还进一步探索基于Transformer编码器的框架是否能够提供可解释的洞见。我们没有依赖LIME或Deep SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）等外部事后解释方法，而是利用模型内在的注意力权重作为内部可解释性信号，以识别潜在重要特征。为进一步支持这一分析，我们在BBBP和MUTAG数据集上开展了案例研究。使用MACCS和PubChem作为输入的MLP + TL模型能够捕获决定血脑屏障（BBB）通透性和Salmonella typhimurium致突变性的、具有化学可解释性的基团。特别是，Morphine和Heroin的比较突出了羟基相关子结构在BBB通透性预测中的作用，而这一点在注意力权重中得到了稳定反映。总体而言，我们的研究为选择有效的分子编码提供了实践指导，并促进了可解释分子信息学方法在药物发现中的发展。

items.title: Entropy-driven adaptive neural architecture search for cell segmentation on edge devices
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Accurate and real-time segmentation of cells in microscopy images is a critical task in biomedical research. Incubator-like edge devices are increasingly being used for real-time monitoring of cellular activities, facilitating timely intervention, which is particularly important when studying dynamic cellular processes. However, adapting to the deployment requirements of diverse edge devices, particularly those with limited resources, presents significant challenges in network architecture design. This requires considering resource constraints and hardware metrics associated with different edge devices, necessitating rigorous control of model complexity and resource utilisation. To address these challenges, we propose a hardware-aware neural architecture search method based on the U-Net backbone to segment various cell types. By incorporating hardware-based penalty terms and an entropy-driven mechanism, our method optimizes the search strategy to maximize segmentation accuracy while ensuring compatibility with target hardware. We evaluated our approach on five resource-constrained hardware platforms and achieved competitive segmentation performance on ten 2D live-cell imaging datasets from the Cell Tracking Challenge, while maintaining favourable hardware efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 提出熵驱动、硬件感知的神经架构搜索，用于资源受限边缘设备上的细胞图像分割。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在5种硬件平台和Cell Tracking Challenge的10个二维活细胞数据集上评估，兼顾分割性能与部署效率。
items.abstract_zh: 准确且实时地分割细胞显微图像是生物医学研究中的关键任务。类似培养箱的边缘设备正越来越多地用于实时监测细胞活动，这对研究动态细胞过程尤其重要，因为它可以及时干预。然而，要适应不同边缘设备的部署要求，特别是在资源有限的设备上设计网络架构，仍然面临重大挑战。这需要考虑不同边缘设备的资源限制和硬件指标，并严格控制模型复杂度和资源利用率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种以U-Net为骨干的硬件感知神经架构搜索方法，用于分割不同细胞类型。通过引入基于硬件的惩罚项和熵驱动机制，我们的方法优化搜索策略，在确保与目标硬件兼容的同时最大化分割准确率。我们在5个资源受限的硬件平台上评估该方法，并在Cell Tracking Challenge的10个二维活细胞成像数据集上取得具有竞争力的分割性能，同时保持良好的硬件效率。
items.author_line: Xu Y, Khan TM, Zhu Y, Song Y, Meijering E

items.title: Investigating the Ligandin Activity of Schistosoma mansoni Glutathione S-Transferases Toward Testosterone: Implications for Novel Anthelminthic Drug Target Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Schistosomiasis is one of the most common neglected tropical diseases globally, with more than 250 million people affected, and praziquantel is the only broadly available chemotherapeutic agent. However, concerns regarding decreased susceptibility to the drug and the lack of alternative therapies underscore the need to identify new therapeutic targets. Glutathione S -transferases (GSTs) are enzymes with diverse biological functions, including parasite detoxification, antioxidant defense, and ligand transport. This study investigated the interaction of 26- and 28-kDa GST isoforms from Schistosoma species with testosterone, which was evaluated as a potential anthelmintic. Testosterone did not exhibit acute vermicidal activity, as adult Schistosoma mansoni worms remained motile after 60 min, whereas praziquantel caused immediate complete immobilization. Homology models of S. mansoni Sm 26GST and Sm 28GST were validated by Ramachandran analysis and showed conserved catalytic cores with variable substrate-binding loops. Recombinant Sj 26GST and Sh 28GST were successfully overexpressed and purified. Both enzymes were inhibited by testosterone in a concentration-dependent manner, with IC₅₀ values of 0.63 mM and 0.73 mM, respectively. Far-UV Circular dichroism and extrinsic ANS fluorescence spectroscopy confirmed the conformational changes caused by the ligands. Induced-fit docking showed that the binding pocket is conserved at the GST dimer interface, and the 500-ns molecular dynamics simulations showed that the complexes were more stable than the apo proteins, with Sm 28GST being more rigid. Testosterone analogues were identified by high-throughput virtual screening that predicted binding affinities higher than those of testosterone. The results suggest that schistosome GSTs are promising targets for structure-based drug discovery against schistosomes.
items.summary_zh: 结合结构建模、生化实验、对接和分子动力学，研究Schistosoma mansoni GST与testosterone的配体活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对影响超过2.5亿人的血吸虫病，提出GST作为结构基础抗血吸虫药物发现靶点，但目前证据仍主要来自体外和计算分析。
items.abstract_zh: 血吸虫病是全球最常见的被忽视热带病之一，影响超过2.5亿人，而praziquantel是唯一广泛可用的化学治疗药物。然而，人们担心对该药的敏感性下降且缺乏替代疗法，因此有必要确定新的治疗靶点。谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）具有多种生物学功能，包括寄生虫解毒、抗氧化防御和配体转运。本研究考察了Schistosoma物种的26-kDa和28-kDa GST亚型与testosterone的相互作用，并将testosterone作为潜在抗血吸虫药物进行评估。testosterone没有表现出急性杀虫活性：成年Schistosoma mansoni蠕虫在60分钟后仍保持运动，而praziquantel会立即使其完全失去活动能力。S. mansoni Sm 26GST和Sm 28GST的同源性模型通过Ramachandran分析进行了验证，显示出保守的催化核心和可变的底物结合环。重组Sj 26GST和Sh 28GST成功过表达并纯化。两种酶均受到testosterone浓度依赖性的抑制，IC₅₀分别为0.63 mM和0.73 mM。远紫外圆二色谱和外源ANS荧光光谱证实了配体引起的构象变化。诱导契合对接显示，结合口袋在GST二聚体界面处是保守的；500-ns分子动力学模拟显示，复合物比脱辅基蛋白更稳定，其中Sm 28GST的刚性更高。通过高通量虚拟筛选鉴定出预测结合亲和力高于testosterone的testosterone类似物。结果表明，血吸虫GST是针对血吸虫进行结构基础药物发现的有前景靶点。
items.author_line: Ndili C, Netshiheni T, Mwangi I, Mutuku M, Onisuru O, Mobegi V, Achilonu I

items.title: AMMPER-2: A spatially explicit agent-based model of microbial radiobiology with redox dye simulation
items.abstract_or_text: To reduce health risks for human space exploration, it is important to model the effects of deep-space radiation on biological systems. The budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a common model organism in space radiobiology, but little is known about how radiation damage to individual cells translates into the population-level effects that experiments measure. The Agent-Based Model for Microbial Populations Exposed to Radiation (AMMPER) is a spatially explicit agent-based model that simulates the effects of ionizing radiation on S. cerevisiae cells and produces population-level results. Its goal is to improve experiment design and data interpretation. AMMPER-1 demonstrated that agent-based simulations can qualitatively reproduce the effects of proton radiation on the growth rate of wild-type and DNA-repair mutant yeast. Here, we present AMMPER-2, which addresses limitations of the first model and expands its capabilities. AMMPER-2 incorporates the dynamics of the redox dye alamarBlue, a data type commonly generated in spaceflight microbiology experiments, and models the fate of reactive oxygen species in more detail. It also adds an improved graphical interface and runs faster. AMMPER-2 remains easy to execute in Python on a standard personal laptop, providing space biologists a tool to explore experimental conditions, generate hypotheses, and interpret data from microbial space radiation experiments.
items.summary_zh: AMMPER-2是用于模拟深空辐射下酵母群体效应的空间显式Agent-Based Model，加入氧化还原染料和活性氧动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型可在普通笔记本上运行，连接单细胞辐射损伤与群体读数，支持空间生物学实验设计和结果解释。
items.abstract_zh: 为了降低人类太空探索的健康风险，模拟深空辐射对生物系统的影响十分重要。出芽酵母Saccharomyces cerevisiae是空间辐射生物学中常用的模式生物，但人们对单个细胞的辐射损伤如何转化为实验测量的群体效应知之甚少。用于模拟暴露于辐射的微生物群体的Agent-Based Model（AMMPER）是一个空间显式的Agent-Based Model，能够模拟电离辐射对S. cerevisiae细胞的影响并产生群体层面的结果。其目标是改进实验设计和数据解释。AMMPER-1表明，基于Agent的模拟能够定性重现质子辐射对野生型和DNA修复突变酵母生长速率的影响。在此，我们介绍AMMPER-2，它解决了第一代模型的局限并扩展了模型能力。AMMPER-2加入了氧化还原染料alamarBlue的动力学——这是空间飞行微生物学实验中常见的数据类型——并更详细地模拟活性氧的命运。它还增加了改进的图形界面并提高运行速度。AMMPER-2仍然易于在普通个人笔记本上的Python中运行，为空间生物学家探索实验条件、生成假设以及解释微生物空间辐射实验数据提供工具。
items.author_line: Palacios, D., Lee, J., Sharma, P., Marous, M., Mejia, D., Liddell, L., Gentry, D., Santa Maria, S.

items.title: T-cell dysregulation is implicated in the encephalopathy of prematurity
items.abstract_or_text: Preterm birth is strongly linked to systemic inflammation and encephalopathy of prematurity, which underlies subsequent cognitive impairment. T-cell immunity contributes to brain-immune crosstalk across the life course but its role in the pathogenesis of encephalopathy of prematurity is unknown. Protein epigenetic scores are DNA methylation (DNAm)-based proxies of circulating proteins. We tested the hypothesis that T-cell dysregulation has a specific role in child neurodevelopment following preterm birth. Multimodal data were collected from 144 preterm infants (median gestational age at birth 29+5 weeks [range 23+3 to 32+6]) recruited to a prospective cohort study: saliva DNAm for protein epigenetic score derivation and brain MRI, both at term-equivalent age, and the Mullen Scales of Early Learning Composite score at 5 years from a subset. We investigated associations of the epigenetic scores for cytotoxic and regulatory T cell-associated molecule (DNAm CRTAM) and C-reactive protein (DNAm CRP; a non-specific marker of inflammation) with MRI metrics of encephalopathy of prematurity: global and regional brain volumes, and general factors of diffusion tensor imaging and neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging metrics averaged across 42 white matter tracts. We tested whether DNAm CRTAM explains more variance than DNAm CRP in MRI metrics of the encephalopathy of prematurity and cognitive scores in childhood. Higher neonatal DNAm CRTAM was associated with lower general factor of fractional anisotropy ({beta} = -0.252, q = 0.011) and higher general factors of radial diffusivity ({beta} = 0.215, q = 0.039), mean diffusivity ({beta} = 0.198, q = 0.047) and orientation dispersion index ({beta} = 0.201, q = 0.048), independent of inflammatory morbidities and other biological covariates after false discovery rate correction. DNAm CRTAM explained more variance than DNAm CRP (maximum incremental R2 = 4.2% vs 1.5%) in diffusion MRI metrics. Higher neonatal DNAm CRTAM was associated with lower cognitive scores at 5 years, independent of DNAm CRP and other covariates ({beta} = -0.332, P = 0.008), and explained more variance in cognitive scores than DNAm CRP (incremental R2 = 9.4% vs 1.2%). An epigenetic proxy of CRTAM in preterm infants is associated with both encephalopathy of prematurity in the neonatal period and lower cognitive performance at 5 years, explaining greater incremental variance than a non-specific marker of inflammation. The data implicate T-cell dysregulation in the pathophysiology of atypical neurodevelopment following preterm birth.
items.summary_zh: 前瞻性队列研究以DNA甲基化蛋白表观遗传评分、脑MRI和5岁认知结局分析早产儿T细胞失调与脑病的关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 样本包含144名早产儿并有纵向认知结局；结果支持相关性证据，不能据此断言T细胞失调造成脑病。
items.abstract_zh: 早产与全身炎症和早产儿脑病密切相关，而早产儿脑病会导致后续认知障碍。T细胞免疫在整个生命过程中参与脑-免疫串扰，但其在早产儿脑病发病机制中的作用尚不清楚。蛋白质表观遗传评分是基于DNA甲基化（DNAm）的循环蛋白代理指标。我们检验了这样一个假设：T细胞失调在早产后儿童神经发育中具有特异性作用。我们从一项前瞻性队列中收集了144名早产儿的多模态数据：在足月等效年龄时采集唾液DNAm以推导蛋白质表观遗传评分并进行脑MRI，在其中一部分儿童5岁时测量Mullen早期学习综合评分。我们研究了细胞毒性和调节性T细胞相关分子（DNAm CRTAM）以及C反应蛋白（DNAm CRP，一种非特异性炎症指标）的表观遗传评分与早产儿脑病MRI指标之间的关系，包括全脑和区域脑体积，以及在42条白质束上取平均的弥散张量成像和神经突定向分散与密度成像指标的一般因子。我们检验了DNAm CRTAM在脑病MRI指标和儿童期认知评分中所解释的方差是否多于DNAm CRP。新生儿DNAm CRTAM较高与较低的一般分数分数各向异性（β = -0.252，q = 0.011）以及较高的一般径向弥散率（β = 0.215，q = 0.039）、平均弥散率（β = 0.198，q = 0.047）和定向分散指数（β = 0.201，q = 0.048）相关；在错误发现率校正后，这些关系独立于炎症性疾病和其他生物学协变量。与DNAm CRP相比，DNAm CRTAM解释了更多弥散MRI指标的方差（最大增量R2 = 4.2% 对 1.5%）。新生儿DNAm CRTAM较高与5岁时较低的认知评分相关，在控制DNAm CRP和其他协变量后仍然成立（β = -0.332，P = 0.008），并且比DNAm CRP解释了更多认知评分方差（增量R2 = 9.4% 对 1.2%）。早产儿中CRTAM的表观遗传代理指标与新生儿期的早产儿脑病和5岁时较低的认知表现均相关，且解释的增量方差大于非特异性炎症指标。这些数据表明，T细胞失调参与非典型神经发育的病理生理过程。
items.author_line: Smikle-Bernard, R., Blesa Cabez, M., Vaher, K., Amir, R., Mckinnon, K., Murphy, L., Thrippleton, M. J., Quigley, A. J., Bastin, M. E., Reynolds, R. M., Whalley, H. C., Marioni, R. E., Cox, S. R., Boardman, J. P.

items.title: Neural signatures of glioma progression using implanted neural interfaces
items.abstract_or_text: High-grade glioma is an incurable brain cancer with a median survival of approximately 14 months. Over the last 50 years, small improvements in patient outcomes have been overshadowed by significant progress in most other cancers. Yet, emerging research has revealed that neural circuits play an active and central role in driving glioma growth and proliferation, highlighting the nervous system as a promising avenue for both disease monitoring and therapeutic intervention. Here, we present a platform for chronically monitoring tumor progression using neural recordings in freely behaving mice with gliomas. Using this platform across multiple mouse strains and glioma models, we show that neural recordings can accurately track tumor progression in vivo. Cancer progression was consistently associated with elevated gamma-band neural activity in the tumor microenvironment across both adult glioblastoma (GBM) and pediatric diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) cancer models. Interestingly, lower frequency neural activity exhibited distinct, cell-line specific changes over time: GBM models exhibited decreases in low frequency neural activity whereas DIPG models exhibited increases over time. Finally, using machine learning models applied to chronic neural recordings from tumor-bearing mice treated with or without standard-of-care chemotherapy (temozolomide for GBM), we accurately predicted tumor burden as inferred through in vivo bioluminescence imaging. By fitting low-dimensional mathematical models to gamma-band neural trajectories, we could further predict individual tumor growth rates over a 5-week period with high accuracy. These results establish that pathological neural-tumor interactions can be harnessed to monitor glioma progression in vivo. Coupling this monitoring capability with therapeutic electrical stimulation in the same device could open up a new class of implantable, closed-loop neurotechnologies with the potential to transform glioma treatment.
items.summary_zh: 植入式神经接口结合神经记录和机器学习，在多种小鼠胶质瘤模型中追踪肿瘤进展并预测肿瘤负荷。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将神经-肿瘤信号、体内生物发光和治疗状态结合，展示闭环神经技术监测胶质瘤的潜力，但证据仍来自小鼠。
items.abstract_zh: 高级别胶质瘤是一种无法治愈的脑癌，中位生存期约为14个月。在过去50年中，患者结局仅有小幅改善，而其他大多数癌症却取得了显著进展。然而，越来越多的研究显示，神经回路在驱动胶质瘤生长和增殖方面发挥主动且核心的作用，提示神经系统可能成为疾病监测和治疗干预的有前景方向。在此，我们提出一种平台，用于在自由活动的胶质瘤小鼠中长期监测肿瘤进展。利用该平台，并覆盖多个小鼠品系和胶质瘤模型，我们显示神经记录能够在体内准确追踪肿瘤进展。在成人胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）和儿童弥漫性内生性脑桥胶质瘤（DIPG）模型中，癌症进展始终与肿瘤微环境中升高的γ频段神经活动相关。有趣的是，低频神经活动随时间呈现细胞系特异性变化：GBM模型中的低频活动下降，而DIPG模型中的低频活动随时间增加。最后，将机器学习模型应用于长期神经记录（这些记录来自接受或未接受标准护理化疗的荷瘤小鼠；GBM使用temozolomide），我们能够准确预测由体内生物发光成像推断的肿瘤负荷。通过对γ频段轨迹拟合低维数学模型，我们还能够高精度预测单个肿瘤在5周内的生长速率。这些结果表明，可以利用病理性神经-肿瘤相互作用来在体内监测胶质瘤。将这种监测能力与同一设备中的治疗性电刺激结合，有望开启一类新的植入式闭环神经技术，并可能改变胶质瘤治疗。
items.author_line: Stroud, J. P., Bratsch-Prince, J., Coles, L., Middya, S., Mediavilla, L., Shamardani, K., Zamani, P. T., Malhotra, K. R., Burde, T., Kazieczko, D., Kumar, A. S., McDonald, J., Dziuba, I., Zhou, J., Henderson, R., Miranda, J. A., Monje, M., Woodington, B., Jenkins, E. P. W.

items.title: Evolutionarily Conserved Plasmodium falciparum HSP70-3 Enhances the Immunogenicity of the Established Malaria Vaccine Antigen Circumsporozoite Protein through Cross-Presentation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Clinically approved P. falciparum circumsporozoite protein (PfCSP)-based pre-erythrocytic stage malaria vaccines suffer from sub-optimal efficacy and rapidly waning memory. By decoding these limitations, we fast-tracked vaccine optimization by correcting CSPs fragile immunogenicity using a parasite-derived chaperone. Unlike other orthologues of P. falciparum heat shock protein 70 (PfHSP70), substrate-binding domain (SBD) of PfHSP70-3 is an evolutionarily conserved internal mitochondrial matrix chaperone. We demonstrate that PfHSP70-3-SBD hydrophobic region complexes with PfCSP and targets host CD91 on antigen-presenting cells to trigger cross-presentation, resulting in enhanced immune responses to PfCSP. Methods: In silico analyses predicted interactions among PfHSP70-3-SBD, PfCSP, and CD91 receptor. Recombinant PfHSP70-3-SBD and PfCSP proteins were purified and assessed for in vitro interaction using ELISA and far-western dot blot assays. BALB/c mice were immunized with alum-formulated PfCSP, with or without PfHSP70-3-SBD. PfCSP-specific IgG and IFN-{gamma} expression were evaluated by ELISA and RT-qPCR, respectively. Functional activity was assessed using transgenic Plasmodium berghei expressing PfCSP (Pb/Pf CSP), by sporozoite neutralization assay. Findings: PfHSP70-3-SBD demonstrated a specific interaction with PfCSP. The complex primarily engages CD91 receptor cluster IV, providing a potential mechanistic basis for antigen cross-presentation. Incorporation of PfHSP70-3-SBD enhanced PfCSP-specific total IgG responses and increased IFN-gamma expression in BALB/c mice, indicating improved immunogenicity upon co-formulation. Notably, immune sera neutralized Pb/Pf CSP sporozoites, delaying blood-stage patency until day 12 in 40% of C57BL/6 mice, with no detectable parasitemia in surviving mice for up to 2 months, indicating sustained efficacy against the sporozoite stage. Interpretation: Molecular chaperones, including HSPs, are currently under intense investigation for their immune-potentiating activity, leading to next-generation vaccine development. By utilizing chaperonic domains derived directly from the pathogenic agent itself to serve an essential adjuvant function, this approach reduces reliance on heterologous adjuvants while enhancing antigen-specific immunity. Funding: This work was supported by funding from Indian Council of Medical Research (IIRPSG-2024-01-03940). Keywords: Substrate-binding domain, PfHSP70-3, Adjuvant, Cross-presentation, Pre-erythrocytic stage, Plasmodium falciparum
items.summary_zh: 以寄生虫来源的PfHSP70-3-SBD增强PfCSP交叉呈递，在小鼠中提高疟疾疫苗免疫原性并延迟感染。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合计算预测、蛋白互作实验、免疫学检测和转基因寄生虫挑战，提供了从机制到动物验证的证据链。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：临床批准的、基于P. falciparum环子孢子蛋白（PfCSP）的红细胞前期疟疾疫苗存在疗效不足和记忆快速衰减的问题。为了解决这些局限，我们通过寄生虫来源的伴侣蛋白来纠正CSP脆弱的免疫原性，从而加速疫苗优化。与P. falciparum热休克蛋白70（PfHSP70）的其他直系同源蛋白不同，PfHSP70-3的底物结合结构域（SBD）是一种进化保守的线粒体基质内伴侣蛋白。我们证明，PfHSP70-3-SBD的疏水区域与PfCSP形成复合物，并靶向抗原呈递细胞上的CD91，以触发交叉呈递，从而增强针对PfCSP的免疫反应。方法：计算机分析预测了PfHSP70-3-SBD、PfCSP和CD91受体之间的相互作用。重组PfHSP70-3-SBD和PfCSP蛋白经纯化后，使用ELISA和远端蛋白质印迹实验评估体外相互作用。BALB/c小鼠接受含明矾佐剂的PfCSP免疫，或接受加入PfHSP70-3-SBD的相同免疫。通过ELISA和RT-qPCR分别评估PfCSP特异性IgG和IFN-γ表达。使用表达PfCSP的转基因Plasmodium berghei（Pb/Pf CSP）通过子孢子中和实验评估功能活性。结果：PfHSP70-3-SBD与PfCSP发生特异性相互作用。该复合物主要结合CD91受体簇IV，为抗原交叉呈递提供了潜在的机制基础。加入PfHSP70-3-SBD增强了PfCSP特异性总IgG反应，并提高了BALB/c小鼠中的IFN-γ表达，表明共同配方能够改善免疫原性。值得注意的是，免疫血清能够中和Pb/Pf CSP子孢子，使40%的C57BL/6小鼠血液期感染出现推迟至第12天；存活小鼠在最长2个月内均未检测到寄生虫血症，表明其对子孢子期具有持续效力。解读：包括HSP在内的分子伴侣目前正受到广泛研究，因为它们具有增强免疫的活性，可用于开发下一代疫苗。利用直接来源于病原体的伴侣结构域发挥关键佐剂作用，可以减少对异源佐剂的依赖，同时增强抗原特异性免疫。经费：本研究由Indian Council of Medical Research（IIRPSG-2024-01-03940）资助。关键词：底物结合结构域，PfHSP70-3，佐剂，交叉呈递，红细胞前期，Plasmodium falciparum。
items.author_line: Garg, P., Verma, C. K., Gupta, K., Sharma, A., Jawla, S., Jha, N., Saini, S., Kumar, K. A., Ranganathan, A., Singh, S.

items.title: Calibration, Uncertainty, and Data Efficiency of Deep Learning Chest Radiograph Classifiers Under Cross-Dataset Distribution Shift: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose To evaluate the external transportability of source-derived probability calibration for chest radiograph deep learning classifiers under distribution shift and determine its dependence on sample size and disease prevalence. Materials and Methods This retrospective secondary computational analysis of public, de-identified radiographic datasets involved no participant contact or new data collection. Cohort sizes were prespecified by availability without prospective power calculation: 106,686 NIH ChestX-ray14 images (29,323 patients; 1992-2015) for development and internal testing, 20,000 CheXpert images (20,000 patients; October 2002-July 2017), and 14,998 VinBigData images (2018-2020) for external testing. ResNet-18, DenseNet-121, and DeiT-Tiny classifiers for cardiomegaly and pleural effusion were trained across four patient fractions and three seeds (36 fits). Calibrators were fitted exclusively on NIH data. Twelve primary external Brier-score contrasts (temperature-scaled versus raw probabilities) were evaluated using paired cluster-bootstrapping with Holm adjustment. Results Temperature scaling reduced Brier scores in nine of 12 primary contrasts but worsened pleural effusion calibration on VinBigData across all architectures (Brier increases: ResNet-18, 0.001460 [95% CI: 0.001347, 0.001568]; DenseNet-121, 0.001193 [95% CI: 0.001109, 0.001274]; DeiT-Tiny, 0.000498 [95% CI: 0.000417, 0.000577]; all adjusted P=.006). Standardizing class weights to NIH prevalence reversed all CheXpert improvements. Although full versus 10% training improved external AUROC across all comparisons, DeiT-Tiny CheXpert pleural effusion Brier score worsened by 0.007039 despite a 0.032466 AUROC gain. At 80% selective image retention, calibrated ensembles retained only 12.3%-17.2% of VinBigData positive pleural effusion examinations. Conclusion Source-fitted calibration is not uniformly transportable across health systems, and discrimination gains do not guarantee calibrated probabilities. External evaluation must simultaneously assess probability reliability, prevalence shifts, and retained-case composition.
items.summary_zh: 在131,684张多数据集胸片上评估深度学习分类器在分布偏移下的校准、外部可迁移性和数据效率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示区分度提升不等于概率可靠性提升，强调临床模型必须同时评估外部校准、患病率变化和筛选样本构成。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：评估源数据拟合的概率校准在分布偏移下对胸部X线深度学习分类器的外部可迁移性，并确定其对样本量和疾病患病率的依赖。材料与方法：这项回顾性二次计算分析使用了公开、去标识化的影像数据集，不涉及参与者接触或新的数据采集。队列规模由数据可得性预先确定，未进行前瞻性效能计算：用于开发和内部测试的NIH ChestX-ray14包含106,686张图像（29,323名患者，1992-2015年）；外部测试使用20,000张CheXpert图像（20,000名患者，2002年10月-2017年7月）和14,998张VinBigData图像（2018-2020年）。针对心脏增大和胸腔积液，训练了ResNet-18、DenseNet-121和DeiT-Tiny分类器，覆盖4种患者数据比例和3个随机种子（36次拟合）。校准器仅在NIH数据上拟合。采用配对聚类bootstrap并进行Holm校正，评估12个预先指定的外部Brier分数对比（温度缩放与原始概率）。结果：在12个主要对比中，温度缩放有9个降低了Brier分数，但在VinBigData的胸腔积液校准中对所有架构均造成恶化（Brier增加：ResNet-18为0.001460［95% CI：0.001347，0.001568］；DenseNet-121为0.001193［95% CI：0.001109，0.001274］；DeiT-Tiny为0.000498［95% CI：0.000417，0.000577］；调整后P=.006）。将类别权重标准化到NIH患病率后，CheXpert上的所有改善均被逆转。尽管从10%训练量增加到完整训练量在所有比较中都提高了外部AUROC，但DeiT-Tiny在CheXpert胸腔积液任务中的Brier分数恶化了0.007039，尽管AUROC提高了0.032466。在保留80%图像进行选择性预测时，经过校准的集成模型在VinBigData阳性胸腔积液检查中仅保留12.3%-17.2%。结论：源数据拟合的校准并不能在不同卫生系统之间稳定迁移，区分度提升也不保证校准概率可靠。外部评估必须同时考察概率可靠性、患病率偏移和保留病例的构成。

items.title: Temporal multi-omics dataset of a cucurbit–powdery mildew interaction
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Plant-pathogenic fungi are major contributors to global crop losses, yet many of the most damaging groups, especially obligate biotrophs, remain difficult to study. Their strict dependence on living host tissue limits experimental manipulation and has constrained the generation of comprehensive datasets that capture how these pathogens suppress host immunity and reprogram metabolism over time. To expand the resources available for data-driven research, we present a temporally resolved multi-omics dataset characterizing the interaction between Cucumis melo and Podosphaera xanthii , the causal agent of cucurbit powdery mildew and a model obligate biotroph. Inoculated and mock-treated melon leaves were sampled across 12 time points from 12 to 144 hours post inoculation, covering key developmental transitions of the pathogen. The dataset integrates dual RNA-seq and untargeted LC–MS/MS metabolomics generated from the same biological material, accompanied by detailed documentation of experimental design, bioinformatic workflows, quality-control metrics and processed outputs to ensure broad reusability. This resource enables exploration of host–pathogen transcriptional dynamics, stage-specific infection responses, metabolic remodeling and integrative multi-omics analyses of obligate biotrophy.
items.summary_zh: 发布Cucumis melo–Podosphaera xanthii互作的时间分辨双RNA-seq与非靶向LC–MS/MS多组学数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同一生物材料覆盖12个接种后时间点，配有实验设计、质控和处理流程文档，适合宿主-病原体动态与可复用分析。
items.abstract_zh: 植物病原真菌是全球作物损失的重要原因，但许多危害最大的类群，尤其是专性活体营养型病原体，仍然难以研究。它们严格依赖活体宿主组织，限制了实验操作，也阻碍了生成能够描述这些病原体如何随时间抑制宿主免疫和重编程代谢的综合数据集。为扩展数据驱动研究可用的资源，我们提供了一个时间分辨的多组学数据集，用于刻画Cucumis melo与Podosphaera xanthii之间的互作；后者是瓜类白粉病的致病因，也是专性活体营养型病原体的模式。接种和模拟处理的甜瓜叶片在接种后12至144小时的12个时间点取样，覆盖病原体发育的关键转换阶段。该数据集整合了来自同一生物材料的双RNA-seq和非靶向LC–MS/MS代谢组学，并配有详细的实验设计、生物信息学流程、质量控制指标和处理后输出文档，以确保广泛复用。该资源可用于研究宿主-病原体转录动态、阶段特异性侵染反应、代谢重塑以及专性活体营养的整合多组学分析。
items.author_line: Jiménez-Sánchez A, Fernández-Ortuño D, Pastor V, Polonio Á, Pérez-García A

items.title: Determining cellular phylogeny and migration at high resolution in spatial genomics
items.abstract_or_text: Cellular migration and tumor evolution are central to tissue homeostasis and cancer biology. Rapid advances in spatial genomics have raised the possibility of using somatic mutations to track these processes in situ in human tissues. However, frequent data dropouts in spatial genomics measurements make this challenging to implement. Here, we present StarTrak (SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing), a framework for somatic variant calling and lineage reconstruction at single-pixel spatial resolution. StarTrak employs a neural network framework to integrate mutational evidence (from both nuclear and mitochondrial reads), spatial proximity, histological images, and transcriptomic states to identify spatially informative patterns of mutations. It performs robustly across tissue types and spatial-omics platforms (being particularly successful with spatial ATAC-seq). Applying StarTrak to tumor sections, we infer the migration of mutated tumor cells into adjacent non-malignant tissues and reconstruct distinct lineage trees associated with different spatial regions. Notably, we identify tumor regions with nearly identical transcriptomic states but distinct mutational profiles. Moreover, for skin sections, StarTrak identifies sunlight-associated mutations in non-malignant epidermis and evidence suggesting the migration of these mutant surface cells into deeper skin layers. Overall, by integrating mutation calling with spatial context, StarTrak enables the inference of spatially resolved cellular migration and cellular phylogeny.
items.summary_zh: StarTrak整合体细胞和线粒体突变、空间邻近、组织学图像与转录状态，在单像素分辨率重建细胞谱系和迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该神经网络框架跨组织和空间组学平台工作，并在肿瘤和皮肤样本中推断突变细胞的空间迁移。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞迁移和肿瘤演化是组织稳态与癌症生物学的核心过程。空间基因组学的快速发展带来了在人体组织原位利用体细胞突变追踪这些过程的可能性。然而，空间基因组学测量中频繁出现的数据缺失使这一目标难以实现。在此，我们提出StarTrak（SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing），这是一个在单像素空间分辨率上进行体细胞变异检测和谱系重建的框架。StarTrak使用神经网络框架整合来自核和线粒体读段的突变证据、空间邻近性、组织学图像和转录状态，以识别具有空间信息的突变模式。它在不同组织类型和空间组学平台上表现稳健，在空间ATAC-seq上尤其成功。将StarTrak应用于肿瘤切片后，我们推断出突变肿瘤细胞向邻近非恶性组织的迁移，并重建了与不同空间区域相关的独立谱系树。值得注意的是，我们发现一些肿瘤区域具有几乎相同的转录状态，却拥有不同的突变谱。此外，在皮肤切片中，StarTrak识别出非恶性表皮中的日光相关突变，并发现证据提示这些突变的表面细胞迁移到了更深的皮肤层。总体而言，通过将突变检测与空间背景整合，StarTrak实现了空间分辨的细胞迁移和细胞谱系推断。
items.author_line: Zhang, D., Jiang, Y., Yu, X., Bai, D., Tian, J., Enninful, A., Tian, X., Li, H., Huo, Y., Chen, Y., Yao, N., Li, J., Chu, Z., Bai, Z., Fan, R., Lu, J., Gerstein, M.

items.title: Lipid nanoparticle-mediated RNAi targeting of KRAS mutants sensitises colorectal cancer cells to chemotherapy
items.abstract_or_text: KRAS mutations, including G12D, G12V and G13D, are major oncogenic drivers in colorectal cancer (CRC) and are associated with therapeutic resistance. However, approved KRAS inhibitors remain focused on G12C subtype, leaving these prevalent variants without approved targeted therapies. Here, we developed a lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-based RNA interference (RNAi) strategy to target these three KRAS variants using a single small interfering RNA (siRNA) sequence. The developed siRNA-LNPs reduced KRAS mRNA and protein expression in HCT116 (G13D), SW620 (G12V) and LS180 (G12D) cells, but not in KRAS wild-type HT29 cells, suppressing the cellular proliferation, clonogenic survival and migration. Transcriptomic profiling revealed changes in KRAS associated signalling, including suppression of cell-cycle and DNA repair programmes, providing a rationale for combining siRNA silencing with the fluoropyrimidine chemotherapeutic agent 5-fluorouracil (5-FU). The combination produced synergistic effects across all three KRAS-mutant CRC cell models and enhanced the apoptosis in both monolayer cultures and 3D spheroids. Collectively, these findings provide proof of concept for this combination strategy and support its further investigation as a potential therapeutic approach for KRAS-mutant CRC.
items.summary_zh: 开发单条siRNA的LNP递送RNAi策略，靶向KRAS G12D、G12V和G13D突变，并与5-FU联合治疗结直肠癌细胞。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在多种KRAS突变细胞和3D球体中观察到协同效应，并用转录组解释细胞周期和DNA修复程序变化；仍属体外概念验证。
items.abstract_zh: KRAS突变，包括G12D、G12V和G13D，是结直肠癌（CRC）的主要致癌驱动因素，并与治疗耐药相关。然而，获批的KRAS抑制剂仍主要针对G12C亚型，使这些常见变体缺乏获批的靶向治疗。我们开发了一种基于脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）的RNA干扰（RNAi）策略，使用单条小干扰RNA（siRNA）序列靶向这三种KRAS变体。所开发的siRNA-LNP降低了HCT116（G13D）、SW620（G12V）和LS180（G12D）细胞中的KRAS mRNA和蛋白表达，但在KRAS野生型HT29细胞中没有这一作用，并抑制了细胞增殖、克隆存活和迁移。转录组分析显示KRAS相关信号发生变化，包括细胞周期和DNA修复程序受到抑制，这为将siRNA沉默与氟嘧啶类化疗药物5-fluorouracil（5-FU）联合提供了依据。在三种KRAS突变CRC细胞模型中，该联合方案均产生协同效应，并在单层培养和3D球体中增强凋亡。总体而言，这些结果为该联合策略提供了概念验证，并支持进一步研究其作为KRAS突变CRC潜在治疗方案的可行性。
items.author_line: Wang, Y., Su, S., Zahra, K., Sang, R., Molloy, M. P., Hutvagner, G., Deng, W.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy of deep learning for microsatellite instability prediction in gastric cancer: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning (DL) applied to haematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained pathology images can predict microsatellite instability (MSI) in gastric cancer (GC). We evaluated its diagnostic accuracy and discriminative performance. PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and Web of Science were searched for studies applying DL to H&E images for MSI prediction in GC. The protocol was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261503140). Risk of bias was assessed with QUADAS-2. Pooled sensitivity and specificity were estimated with a bivariate random-effects model, with subgroup analyses by validation strategy and data source; slide-level areas under the curve (AUCs) were pooled after logit transformation. Prespecified scenario analyses assessed robustness. Ten studies were included; seven independent datasets from six studies entered the primary synthesis. Pooled sensitivity, specificity and summary receiver operating characteristic AUC were 0.78 (95% CI 0.63-0.88), 0.85 (95% CI 0.77-0.90) and 0.89 (95% CI 0.86-0.91); nine studies contributed to the secondary AUC synthesis (pooled AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.89). Hospital-derived cohorts showed numerically higher sensitivity (0.86) and diagnostic odds ratio (39.8) than TCGA-derived cohorts (0.71 and 11.5), but subgroup differences were limited by the small number of studies and substantial heterogeneity. DL models show good diagnostic accuracy for MSI prediction in GC, but clinical utility still requires confirmation in standardised multicentre, independent external and prospective studies.
items.summary_zh: 系统综述和Meta分析汇总深度学习从胃癌H&E病理图像预测微卫星不稳定性的诊断准确性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 纳入10项研究和7个独立数据集，显示总体诊断性能良好，但临床应用仍需标准化、多中心、独立外部和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 应用于苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色病理图像的深度学习（DL）可以预测胃癌（GC）中的微卫星不稳定性（MSI）。我们评估了其诊断准确性和区分性能。我们检索了PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和Web of Science中使用H&E图像预测GC中MSI的研究。研究方案已在PROSPERO中前瞻性注册（CRD420261503140）。使用QUADAS-2评估偏倚风险。采用双变量随机效应模型估计合并敏感度和特异度；根据验证策略和数据来源进行亚组分析；在logit转换后合并切片级曲线下面积（AUC）。预先指定的情景分析评估结果的稳健性。共纳入10项研究；其中6项研究的7个独立数据集进入主要综合分析。合并敏感度、特异度和汇总受试者工作特征AUC分别为0.78（95% CI 0.63-0.88）、0.85（95% CI 0.77-0.90）和0.89（95% CI 0.86-0.91）；9项研究贡献了次要AUC综合分析（合并AUC 0.85，95% CI 0.80-0.89）。医院来源队列的敏感度（0.86）和诊断优势比（39.8）在数值上高于TCGA来源队列（分别为0.71和11.5），但由于研究数量少且异质性显著，亚组差异受到限制。DL模型在GC的MSI预测中显示出良好诊断准确性，但其临床效用仍需在标准化、多中心、独立外部和前瞻性研究中确认。
items.author_line: Du, Y., Liao, H., Li, J., He, Y., Di, J.

review.note: 选出16项，均为 publication_status=preprint；候选集中没有 peer_reviewed 或 clinical 状态的项目。因最高分系统综述的摘要在候选文件中被截断，未纳入，以确保 abstract_zh 为完整、准确翻译。排序综合生物学意义、方法创新、数据规模、实验或临床证据与可复现性。
